title: Pseudo-coherence of an object is independent of the representing complex and can be checked locally
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states three properties of m-pseudo-coherence: locality on a covering when C has a final object, independence of the representing complex, and locality in general (statement lines 12065-12082). The proof (proof lines 12084-12107) represents the local maps by maps of complexes on a refinement, reads off pseudo-coherence of an arbitrary representative, passes from localisations to the global statement, and invokes the covering axioms for the general local case. H2: two short arguments from the definitions, written out.
